rules.statement: A token that carries the membership marker together with role or policy claims fails closed: Indeterminate(MembershipUnavailable).
When the MembershipProvider is missing, fails or times out, the decision is Indeterminate(MembershipUnavailable); it never falls back to the token's claims or to no memberships.

Membership claims are read thus: `role` is a role in the default space, `role@space` a role in that space only, and a malformed entry (empty role or space, more than one @, `role@*`) applies in no space.

After revokeSubject(tenant, principal, issuedBefore), every token of that principal issued before the instant, or up to cosec.authentication.revocation.skew after it, is rejected: by the pipeline and by refresh alike, with the same skew, so a token the pipeline refuses is never renewed.

The memberships a MembershipLoader answered are held by the process that loaded them, at most cosec.authorization.membership.ttl from the answer; no membership is read from Redis, or from any store another process can write, as the provider's answer, and none is written there. Only invalidation frames, which carry keys and no memberships, cross between instances, and a frame can only make an instance load again.
guards: spring-boot:MembershipsStayLocalStarterTest#a membership record in Redis is never the provider's answer, and none is written
cocache:LocalMembershipsTest#concurrent misses of one key share one load, and it answers them all
